assumptions.message: Greenhouse Operator is the primary default operational role assigned upon registration, while Greenhouse Administrator manages devices and alert rules.
Sensors record temperature, humidity, CO2 ppm, and soil moisture percent on a minute-by-minute cadence.
Bench cameras capture snapshots with identified pest name and confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0.
Alert severity is assigned as an enum (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL) to assist operator prioritization.
Applied leaf green (#2e7d32) accent with crisp light background (#f9fbf9) and Swiss style for dense telemetry charts as requested.
Design direction: Weather App (Hero-Centric Design); palette Atmospheric gradients (sky blue → sunset → storm grey) + temp scale; fonts Spatial Clear (Inter / Inter); from ui-ux-pro-max@28b3b8dee8c9
